proposals.evidence: The complete broken-state response is tūṭ-/ṭuṭ- break plus gay-/gel-/go gone. Turner truṭyati lists the Hindi, Bhojpuri, Awadhi and western Pahari break verb and its broken participles; gata supplies the second member. Both members are represented despite fusion in the transcription.
